name: domain_systems__personal_assistant_ant__crewai_orch
description: CrewAI system routine that builds the shared LLM, instantiates the personal assistant orchestrator plus reader/action/writer workers, and loops up to 10 cycles dispatching decisions via _kick until returning either the orchestrator’s final response or a cycle-limit summary.

code_references.snippet:
@mlflow.trace(name="pa_query", span_type=SpanType.CHAIN)
def run_orchestrator(query: str, verbose: bool = False):
    span = mlflow.get_current_active_span()
    if span:
        span.set_attributes({"query": query})
    base_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    os.chdir(base_dir)
    llm = build_llm()

    orchestrator = Agent(
        role="Personal Assistant Orchestrator",
        goal="Iteratively route work to specialist workers and produce a final plain-text response.",
        backstory=ORCHESTRATOR_BACKSTORY,
        llm=llm,
        verbose=verbose,
        max_iter=16,
        allow_delegation=False,
    )
    workers = {
        "reader": Agent(
            role="Reader Worker",
            goal="Search and read workspace data for context.",
            backstory=READER_WORKER_BACKSTORY,
            llm=llm,
            verbose=verbose,
            max_iter=12,
            allow_delegation=False,
            mcps=[mcp_server("workspace_server.py")],
        ),
        "action": Agent(
            role="Action Worker",
            goal="Perform workspace actions: create/update tasks, events, drafts.",
            backstory=ACTION_WORKER_BACKSTORY,
            llm=llm,
            verbose=verbose,
            max_iter=12,
            allow_delegation=False,
            mcps=[mcp_server("action_server.py")],
        ),
        "writer": Agent(
            role="Writer Worker",
            goal="Save summary documents only when explicitly requested.",
            backstory=WRITER_WORKER_BACKSTORY,
            llm=llm,
            verbose=verbose,
            max_iter=8,
            allow_delegation=False,
            tools=[write_personal_summary_document],
        ),
    }

    history: list[str] = []
    instruction = query
    max_cycles = 10

    for cycle in range(1, max_cycles + 1):
        history_text = "\n\n".join(history) if history else "No worker outputs yet."
        decision_raw = _kick(
            orchestrator,
            (
                f"Original user request:\n{query}\n\n"
                f"Current instruction context:\n{instruction}\n\n"
                f"Worker outputs so far:\n{history_text}\n\n"
                f"Cycle: {cycle}/{max_cycles}\n"
                "Decide the next step. "
                "If the user requested both a task update AND an email draft, "
                "you must issue action_worker twice (once per action) or once with both instructions — "
                "do not emit final until both are confirmed with concrete ids.\n"
                f"{ORCHESTRATOR_DECISION_SCHEMA}"
            ),
            verbose,
        )
        decision = _parse_decision(decision_raw)

        if decision["action"] == "final":
            final_response = decision["final_response"].strip()
            if final_response:
                return final_response
            return "Unable to produce final response from orchestrator."

        worker_name = decision["worker"]
        worker_instruction = decision["instruction"].strip() or instruction or query
        worker_output = _kick(
            workers[worker_name],
            (
                f"User request:\n{query}\n\n"
                f"Worker: {worker_name}\n"
                f"Instruction: {worker_instruction}\n\n"
                "Use your tools and return concrete outcomes with evidence (task id, event id, draft id when present)."
            ),
            verbose,
        )
        history.append(f"{worker_name}_output:\n{worker_output}")
        instruction = worker_instruction

    summary = "\n\n".join(history) if history else "No worker outputs collected."
    return f"Stopped after reaching orchestration cycle limit ({max_cycles}). Latest worker outputs:\n{summary}"
from crewai import Agent, Crew, Process, Task

## TASK FILES

**task_001.md**: "Find my Q2 planning meeting with Dana this week and draft an email to her asking if we can move it to Thursday September 19 at 11am instead."

events.content:
{"action": "final", "worker": "reader", "instruction": "", "final_response": "Q2 Feature Launch — Full Status Update

OVERVIEW
The Q2 Feature Launch kicked off on August 13 with Marco (backend lead), Priya (frontend lead), Carla (design), Aisha (data layer), and Leo (budget). The key milestone is a beta launch by October 12, with the ClientCo API integration due October 11. The team agreed on an event-driven microservices architecture (auth-service, payment-service, notification-service) using Kafka, with Ben handling Kubernetes deployment. Known risk areas: the ClientCo integration dependency and tech debt in the payment service (Owen flagged a silent failure on the promo code path in the Q1 review).

TASKS
1. Review project proposal (task001) — Pending, high priority, due September 20. Review Marco's updated proposal (section 3 revised with ClientCo requirements from Mei Lin) and provide written feedback.
2. Prepare Q2 budget summary (task002) — In progress, medium priority, due September 20. Compile Q1 actuals ($142k, $8k under budget) and draft Q2 projections against the $165k target. Watch item: possible 15% VendorCo renewal increase per Tom Fischer.
3. Update Q2 product roadmap (task005) — Pending, medium priority, due September 26. Update based on David Chen's draft, current sprint status, and ClientCo integration requirements.
4. Schedule Q2 team offsite (task009) — Pending, low priority, due October 1. Coordinate venue and date; check availability with Marco, Priya, and Dana. Offsite planning meeting is already scheduled for September 25.
5. Set up CI/CD pipeline for Q2 feature branch (task013) — Done (completed with Ben Nakamura). CI runs on push; CD deploys to staging on merge to main.

BUDGET
Q1 actual spend was $142k ($8k under budget). Q2 budget is $165k: new hires $40k (two engineers — Sofia Bauer is the first hire, second role still open), infrastructure $25k, tools/licenses $15k, contractor work $30k, contingency $15k. VendorCo contract renewal is pending with a possible 15% price increase; Leo is tracking this. Budget review with Leo is scheduled for September 20 at 11:00.

RELEVANT EMAILS FROM THE TEAM
- Marco Elkins (Sep 12, read): Q2 Feature Launch proposal draft is ready, covering backend architecture, API design, and timeline; he asked for feedback by Friday, September 20. You confirmed you would review it.
- Marco Elkins (Sep 14, unread): He updated the proposal with the ClientCo integration requirements from Mei Lin; the main changes are in section 3 (API design). Awaiting your review.
- Mei Lin, ClientCo (Sep 11, read): Asked whether the API integration will be ready by October 11 as agreed. You replied on Sep 12 confirming the team is on track, with Marco leading the work.
- Mei Lin, ClientCo (Sep 13, unread): Follow-up asking whether the data export feature can be added to the current scope before launch. This is an open scope question that needs a decision and reply.
- David Chen (Sep 8, read): The Q2 product roadmap draft is in Confluence — key items are the ClientCo integration (October 11), dashboard redesign (June), and payment flow improvements (Q3). He asked for review before the project review on September 19.
- Dana Reyes (Sep 9–10 thread): Q2 planning meeting confirmed for Tuesday, September 17 at 2pm in Room 3; Dana will send the agenda beforehand. Note: this conflicts with a client call on your calendar.

UPCOMING MEETINGS
- Sep 16, 9:00–10:30: Sprint planning (Q2 sprint kickoff) with Marco, Priya, Owen, and David — conflicts with the team standup.
- Sep 17, 2:00–3:00: Q2 planning meeting with Dana — conflicts with a client call.
- Sep 19, 3:00–4:30: Project review (Q2 Feature Launch milestone review) with Marco, Leo, and David.
- Sep 20, 11:00–12:00: Budget review with Leo.
- Sep 25, 2:00–3:00: Team offsite planning with Marco, Priya, and Dana.

KEY ACTION ITEMS AND RISKS
1. Review Marco's updated proposal (section 3, API design) by September 20 — high priority and currently pending.
2. Respond to Mei Lin's unread request about adding the data export feature to the current scope — a scope decision is needed before the October 11 integration deadline.
3. Review David Chen's roadmap draft before the September 19 project review.
4. Complete the Q2 budget summary by September 20, factoring in the potential 15% VendorCo increase.
5. Address payment-service tech debt (silent failure on promo code path) — flagged as a risk to the launch.
6. Resolve calendar conflicts on September 16 (standup vs. sprint planning) and September 17 (Dana meeting vs. client call).

Overall: the project is on track for the October 12 beta and October 11 ClientCo integration, with CI/CD infrastructure already complete. The main near-term pressure points are the proposal review and budget summary both due September 20, and the open ClientCo scope question about data export."}

arguments.subject: Re: Data Export Feature — Scope Clarification
arguments.body:
Dear Mei Lin,

Thank you for raising the question about adding the data export feature to the project scope.

After reviewing the project scope confirmed on July 27, I must let you know that the data export feature is currently out of scope for this phase of the ClientCo API integration. Our team is fully focused on delivering the agreed scope — including OAuth2.0 authentication and the 99.9% uptime SLA — by the hard deadline of October 11. Adding the export feature mid-sprint would risk scope creep and jeopardize the delivery timeline, a risk you yourself flagged earlier in the project.

That said, we would be happy to discuss including the data export feature in a future phase. David Chen, our PM liaison, can coordinate a follow-up conversation at your convenience to explore requirements and timelines for a subsequent release.

Thank you for your understanding, and please don't hesitate to reach out with any questions in the meantime.

Best regards

nodes.name: orchestrator
nodes.description: CrewAI Agent that acts as the Personal Assistant Orchestrator, using the shared LLM to route tasks to specialist workers and decide when to emit the final plain-text response.

code_references.snippet:
@mlflow.trace(name="pa_query", span_type=SpanType.CHAIN)
def run_orchestrator(query: str, verbose: bool = False):
    span = mlflow.get_current_active_span()
    if span:
        span.set_attributes({"query": query})
    base_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    os.chdir(base_dir)
    llm = build_llm()

    orchestrator = Agent(
        role="Personal Assistant Orchestrator",
        goal="Iteratively route work to specialist workers and produce a final plain-text response.",
        backstory=ORCHESTRATOR_BACKSTORY,
        llm=llm,
        verbose=verbose,
        max_iter=16,
        allow_delegation=False,
    )
    workers = {
        "reader": Agent(
            role="Reader Worker",
            goal="Search and read workspace data for context.",
            backstory=READER_WORKER_BACKSTORY,
            llm=llm,
            verbose=verbose,
            max_iter=12,
            allow_delegation=False,
            mcps=[mcp_server("workspace_server.py")],
        ),
        "action": Agent(
            role="Action Worker",
            goal="Perform workspace actions: create/update tasks, events, drafts.",
            backstory=ACTION_WORKER_BACKSTORY,
            llm=llm,
            verbose=verbose,
            max_iter=12,
            allow_delegation=False,
            mcps=[mcp_server("action_server.py")],
        ),
        "writer": Agent(
            role="Writer Worker",
            goal="Save summary documents only when explicitly requested.",
            backstory=WRITER_WORKER_BACKSTORY,
            llm=llm,
            verbose=verbose,
            max_iter=8,
            allow_delegation=False,
            tools=[write_personal_summary_document],
        ),
    }

    history: list[str] = []
    instruction = query
    max_cycles = 10

    for cycle in range(1, max_cycles + 1):
        history_text = "\n\n".join(history) if history else "No worker outputs yet."
        decision_raw = _kick(
            orchestrator,
            (
                f"Original user request:\n{query}\n\n"
                f"Current instruction context:\n{instruction}\n\n"
                f"Worker outputs so far:\n{history_text}\n\n"
                f"Cycle: {cycle}/{max_cycles}\n"
                "Decide the next step. "
                "If the user requested both a task update AND an email draft, "
                "you must issue action_worker twice (once per action) or once with both instructions — "
                "do not emit final until both are confirmed with concrete ids.\n"
                f"{ORCHESTRATOR_DECISION_SCHEMA}"
            ),
            verbose,
        )
        decision = _parse_decision(decision_raw)

        if decision["action"] == "final":
            final_response = decision["final_response"].strip()
            if final_response:
                return final_response
            return "Unable to produce final response from orchestrator."

        worker_name = decision["worker"]
        worker_instruction = decision["instruction"].strip() or instruction or query
        worker_output = _kick(
            workers[worker_name],
            (
                f"User request:\n{query}\n\n"
                f"Worker: {worker_name}\n"
                f"Instruction: {worker_instruction}\n\n"
                "Use your tools and return concrete outcomes with evidence (task id, event id, draft id when present)."
            ),
            verbose,
        )
        history.append(f"{worker_name}_output:\n{worker_output}")
        instruction = worker_instruction

    summary = "\n\n".join(history) if history else "No worker outputs collected."
    return f"Stopped after reaching orchestration cycle limit ({max_cycles}). Latest worker outputs:\n{summary}"

@mcp.tool()
def create_calendar_event(title: str, date: str, time: str, attendees: str = "", details: str = "") -> str:
    """Create a new calendar event. attendees is a comma-separated list of emails."""
    events = _load("calendar.json")
    new_id = f"cal{str(len(events) + 1).zfill(3)}"
    attendee_list = [a.strip() for a in attendees.split(",") if a.strip()]
    event = {
        "id": new_id, "title": title, "date": date, "time": time,
        "duration_minutes": 60, "attendees": attendee_list,
        "location": "", "notes": details,
    }
    events.append(event)
    _save("calendar.json", events)
    _record_action("create_calendar_event", {"event_id": new_id, "title": title, "date": date})
    return f"Calendar event created: id={new_id}, title={title}, date={date}, time={time}"

nodes.name: reader_worker
nodes.description: CrewAI Agent configured as the Reader Worker that searches and reads workspace data for context using the shared LLM, runs up to 12 iterations without delegation, and accesses workspace_server.py via MCP to gather information.

code_references.snippet:
@mlflow.trace(name="pa_query", span_type=SpanType.CHAIN)
def run_orchestrator(query: str, verbose: bool = False):
    span = mlflow.get_current_active_span()
    if span:
        span.set_attributes({"query": query})
    base_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    os.chdir(base_dir)
    llm = build_llm()

    orchestrator = Agent(
        role="Personal Assistant Orchestrator",
        goal="Iteratively route work to specialist workers and produce a final plain-text response.",
        backstory=ORCHESTRATOR_BACKSTORY,
        llm=llm,
        verbose=verbose,
        max_iter=16,
        allow_delegation=False,
    )
    workers = {
        "reader": Agent(
            role="Reader Worker",
            goal="Search and read workspace data for context.",
            backstory=READER_WORKER_BACKSTORY,
            llm=llm,
            verbose=verbose,
            max_iter=12,
            allow_delegation=False,
            mcps=[mcp_server("workspace_server.py")],
        ),
        "action": Agent(
            role="Action Worker",
            goal="Perform workspace actions: create/update tasks, events, drafts.",
            backstory=ACTION_WORKER_BACKSTORY,
            llm=llm,
            verbose=verbose,
            max_iter=12,
            allow_delegation=False,
            mcps=[mcp_server("action_server.py")],
        ),
        "writer": Agent(
            role="Writer Worker",
            goal="Save summary documents only when explicitly requested.",
            backstory=WRITER_WORKER_BACKSTORY,
            llm=llm,
            verbose=verbose,
            max_iter=8,
            allow_delegation=False,
            tools=[write_personal_summary_document],
        ),
    }

    history: list[str] = []
    instruction = query
    max_cycles = 10

    for cycle in range(1, max_cycles + 1):
        history_text = "\n\n".join(history) if history else "No worker outputs yet."
        decision_raw = _kick(
            orchestrator,
            (
                f"Original user request:\n{query}\n\n"
                f"Current instruction context:\n{instruction}\n\n"
                f"Worker outputs so far:\n{history_text}\n\n"
                f"Cycle: {cycle}/{max_cycles}\n"
                "Decide the next step. "
                "If the user requested both a task update AND an email draft, "
                "you must issue action_worker twice (once per action) or once with both instructions — "
                "do not emit final until both are confirmed with concrete ids.\n"
                f"{ORCHESTRATOR_DECISION_SCHEMA}"
            ),
            verbose,
        )
        decision = _parse_decision(decision_raw)

        if decision["action"] == "final":
            final_response = decision["final_response"].strip()
            if final_response:
                return final_response
            return "Unable to produce final response from orchestrator."

        worker_name = decision["worker"]
        worker_instruction = decision["instruction"].strip() or instruction or query
        worker_output = _kick(
            workers[worker_name],
            (
                f"User request:\n{query}\n\n"
                f"Worker: {worker_name}\n"
                f"Instruction: {worker_instruction}\n\n"
                "Use your tools and return concrete outcomes with evidence (task id, event id, draft id when present)."
            ),
            verbose,
        )
        history.append(f"{worker_name}_output:\n{worker_output}")
        instruction = worker_instruction

    summary = "\n\n".join(history) if history else "No worker outputs collected."
    return f"Stopped after reaching orchestration cycle limit ({max_cycles}). Latest worker outputs:\n{summary}"

READER_WORKER_BACKSTORY = """You are reader_worker.
Search and read the workspace to gather information.
Use search_emails, search_calendar, search_contacts, search_tasks, search_notes, and read_task_file.
CRITICAL: Always use ONE or TWO word keyword queries (e.g. "outage", "ben", "task010") — never phrases or sentences.
Search tools do exact substring matching — long queries almost always return nothing.
If a search returns no results, retry with a single shorter keyword. Try 2-3 different keywords before concluding nothing exists.
Return ONLY raw data from tool outputs. Do not compose emails, suggest actions, or write content on behalf of the user.
Never invent workspace facts. Every claim must come from tool outputs.
Do not perform any write or update actions.
"""

nodes.name: writer_worker
nodes.description: CrewAI Writer Worker agent that shares the system LLM and is limited to running the write_personal_summary_document tool to save personal summary documents when explicitly asked.

code_references.snippet:
@mlflow.trace(name="pa_query", span_type=SpanType.CHAIN)
def run_orchestrator(query: str, verbose: bool = False):
    span = mlflow.get_current_active_span()
    if span:
        span.set_attributes({"query": query})
    base_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    os.chdir(base_dir)
    llm = build_llm()

    orchestrator = Agent(
        role="Personal Assistant Orchestrator",
        goal="Iteratively route work to specialist workers and produce a final plain-text response.",
        backstory=ORCHESTRATOR_BACKSTORY,
        llm=llm,
        verbose=verbose,
        max_iter=16,
        allow_delegation=False,
    )
    workers = {
        "reader": Agent(
            role="Reader Worker",
            goal="Search and read workspace data for context.",
            backstory=READER_WORKER_BACKSTORY,
            llm=llm,
            verbose=verbose,
            max_iter=12,
            allow_delegation=False,
            mcps=[mcp_server("workspace_server.py")],
        ),
        "action": Agent(
            role="Action Worker",
            goal="Perform workspace actions: create/update tasks, events, drafts.",
            backstory=ACTION_WORKER_BACKSTORY,
            llm=llm,
            verbose=verbose,
            max_iter=12,
            allow_delegation=False,
            mcps=[mcp_server("action_server.py")],
        ),
        "writer": Agent(
            role="Writer Worker",
            goal="Save summary documents only when explicitly requested.",
            backstory=WRITER_WORKER_BACKSTORY,
            llm=llm,
            verbose=verbose,
            max_iter=8,
            allow_delegation=False,
            tools=[write_personal_summary_document],
        ),
    }

    history: list[str] = []
    instruction = query
    max_cycles = 10

    for cycle in range(1, max_cycles + 1):
        history_text = "\n\n".join(history) if history else "No worker outputs yet."
        decision_raw = _kick(
            orchestrator,
            (
                f"Original user request:\n{query}\n\n"
                f"Current instruction context:\n{instruction}\n\n"
                f"Worker outputs so far:\n{history_text}\n\n"
                f"Cycle: {cycle}/{max_cycles}\n"
                "Decide the next step. "
                "If the user requested both a task update AND an email draft, "
                "you must issue action_worker twice (once per action) or once with both instructions — "
                "do not emit final until both are confirmed with concrete ids.\n"
                f"{ORCHESTRATOR_DECISION_SCHEMA}"
            ),
            verbose,
        )
        decision = _parse_decision(decision_raw)

        if decision["action"] == "final":
            final_response = decision["final_response"].strip()
            if final_response:
                return final_response
            return "Unable to produce final response from orchestrator."

        worker_name = decision["worker"]
        worker_instruction = decision["instruction"].strip() or instruction or query
        worker_output = _kick(
            workers[worker_name],
            (
                f"User request:\n{query}\n\n"
                f"Worker: {worker_name}\n"
                f"Instruction: {worker_instruction}\n\n"
                "Use your tools and return concrete outcomes with evidence (task id, event id, draft id when present)."
            ),
            verbose,
        )
        history.append(f"{worker_name}_output:\n{worker_output}")
        instruction = worker_instruction

    summary = "\n\n".join(history) if history else "No worker outputs collected."
    return f"Stopped after reaching orchestration cycle limit ({max_cycles}). Latest worker outputs:\n{summary}"

WRITER_WORKER_BACKSTORY = """You are writer_worker.
Save a personal summary document only when the user explicitly asks.
Never claim a save happened unless the tool confirms it.
If no save request exists, return status: not_requested.
"""
from crewai import Agent, Crew, Process, Task

outputs.name: worker_output
outputs.description: Textual result returned by the writer worker after following the instruction (e.g., reporting tool usage or status) that is appended to the orchestration history.

                f"Cycle: {cycle}/{max_cycles}\n"
                "Decide the next step. "
                "If the user requested both a task update AND an email draft, "
                "you must issue action_worker twice (once per action) or once with both instructions — "
                "do not emit final until both are confirmed with concrete ids.\n"
                f"{ORCHESTRATOR_DECISION_SCHEMA}"
            ),
            verbose,
        )
        decision = _parse_decision(decision_raw)

        if decision["action"] == "final":
            final_response = decision["final_response"].strip()
            if final_response:
                return final_response
            return "Unable to produce final response from orchestrator."

        worker_name = decision["worker"]
        worker_instruction = decision["instruction"].strip() or instruction or query
        worker_output = _kick(
            workers[worker_name],
            (
                f"User request:\n{query}\n\n"
                f"Worker: {worker_name}\n"
                f"Instruction: {worker_instruction}\n\n"
                "Use your tools and return concrete outcomes with evidence (task id, event id, draft id when present)."
            ),
            verbose,
        )
        history.append(f"{worker_name}_output:\n{worker_output}")
        instruction = worker_instruction

    summary = "\n\n".join(history) if history else "No worker outputs collected."
    return f"Stopped after reaching orchestration cycle limit ({max_cycles}). Latest worker outputs:\n{summary}"

def build_llm() -> LLM:
    model_name = os.getenv("AZURE_MODEL_NAME")
    api_key = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY")
    endpoint = _azure_root(os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"))
    return LLM(
        model=f"azure/{model_name}",
        api_version=os.getenv("AZURE_API_VERSION"),
        api_key=api_key,
        endpoint=endpoint,
        temperature=0.0,
    )

@tool("write_personal_summary_document")
def write_personal_summary_document(title: str, markdown_content: str) -> str:
    """Save a local markdown personal summary document."""
    safe_title = "".join(ch.lower() if ch.isalnum() else "_" for ch in title).strip("_")
    if not safe_title:
        safe_title = "summary"
    out_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "outputs"
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    timestamp = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    file_path = out_dir / f"{safe_title}_{timestamp}.md"
    file_path.write_text(f"# {title}\n\n{markdown_content.strip()}\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return f"Created summary document: {file_path.name}"
